scripts.dev:backend: bun run --filter backend dev && bun run --filter @repo/db db:studio
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck
scripts.security:image:backend: docker build -f apps/backend/Dockerfile.prod -t wde-backend:scan . && trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed wde-backend:scan
scripts.security:image:frontend: docker build -f apps/frontend/Dockerfile.prod --build-arg VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=local -t wde-frontend:scan . && trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed wde-frontend:scan
scripts.security: bun run security:deps && bun run security:config && bun run security:image:backend && bun run security:image:frontend
